name: vmware-skills
description: VMware vSphere, NSX, Aria and Horizon operations for agents — each plugin ships one skill and its MCP server, with audit logging and policy enforcement shared across the family.

plugins.name: vmware-aiops
plugins.description: AI-powered VMware vCenter/ESXi VM lifecycle and deployment with 60 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-avi
plugins.description: VMware AVI (NSX ALB) load balancer plus AKO Kubernetes ops — 28 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-aria
plugins.description: VMware Aria Operations: metrics, alerts, capacity, anomaly detection — 33 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-debug
plugins.description: Read-only VMware incident correlation: timeline, spikes, root-cause routing. 2 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-log-insight
plugins.description: Read-only VMware Aria Operations for Logs (Log Insight): search + aggregation. 7 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-monitor
plugins.description: Read-only VMware vCenter/ESXi monitoring with 31 MCP tools. Code-level safety.

plugins.name: vmware-nsx
plugins.description: VMware NSX networking management with 33 MCP tools: segments, gateways, NAT, routing, IPAM.

plugins.name: vmware-nsx-security
plugins.description: VMware NSX security: DFW policies, security groups, tags, Traceflow, IDPS — 21 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-pilot
plugins.description: Multi-step workflow orchestration for VMware MCP skills with approval gates and rollback.

plugins.name: vmware-policy
plugins.description: Unified audit logging, policy enforcement, and input sanitization for the VMware MCP skill family.

plugins.name: vmware-privateai
plugins.description: VMware Private AI (NVIDIA): GPU inventory, vGPU profiles, utilization, model serving — 17 tools

plugins.name: vmware-storage
plugins.description: VMware vSphere storage management with 12 MCP tools: datastores, iSCSI, vSAN.

plugins.name: vmware-vdi
plugins.description: VMware/Omnissa Horizon VDI ops: pools, sessions, machines, images — 27 MCP tools.

plugins.name: vmware-vks
plugins.description: vSphere with Tanzu (VKS): Namespace and TanzuKubernetesCluster lifecycle. Requires vSphere 8.x+.
